title: In the Line of Fire
description: At the request of the National Interagency Fire center, 7th Engineer Support Battalion, 1st Marine Logistics Group, quickly trained and embarked on a month long mission to protect people, property and public lands against the Creekfire, and August Complex. The Marines and Sailors were ready at a moments notice and were able to make a large impact in the wild land firefighting efforts.(U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Kevin Seidensticker)
keywords: 7th ESB Marines, National Inter-agency Fire Center, U.S. Army North (Fifth Army)
